name: Aqua-Terrarium 60x35x45x30
label: Medium terrarium
lead: Combined aqua-terrarium measuring 60x35x45 cm. Ideal for animals that need both a land and a water section in their habitat. Water section height: 30 cm.

description.html: This aqua-terrarium has a 60x35 cm floor and a total height of 45 cm, of which 30 cm is for water. That is about 63 liters of water, with 15 cm of free height above it for the land section and the heat lamp. The total volume of the enclosure is approximately 94.5 liters.

A water depth of 30 cm is enough for a young aquatic turtle to submerge completely and turn around, and 60 cm of length gives it a few strokes in a straight line. Place the land area on one side, under the lamp, so the animal can dry off completely. The 35 cm width means it fits on a dresser of standard depth, but the surface must bear some sixty kilograms of water alone.
With 63 liters of water and an island under the lamp, we offer this model for:

items: Amphibians that need an aquatic section

description.html: A wider variant of the same concept already exists in our range as the 60x45x40, and a longer one as the 80x45x50. If neither suits you, we work out the dimensions and the water section height together. The outside gets a decorative film of your choice, and we send the finished aqua-terrarium by courier to your address in Serbia. For changed dimensions, allow for a lead time of 7 to 14 days.
